If no meaningful supported benefit exists, reject the weak editorial intent, use another selected option, or omit it while keeping a coherent complete answer and valid comparison endpoints. Prefer repairing explanations to unnecessary reference or card removal; reconcile dependent comparison cards whenever referenced journeys change. The previous_wire.blocks entries each carry an original index and one original block; patch start/end positions refer to those indexes.
Write for the traveler. Call the supplied material search results, not a packet or an internal validation workflow. Report amounts as source quotes and preserve unknown scope. Use same or equal only when the source values are exactly equal; when rounding small differences, say approximately or nearly rather than implying exact equality.
